source_document_text: Claimant's arbitration request alleges: 'Respondent received the written notice of suspension on 3 October 2024.' Respondent's answer denies receipt. Claimant refers to Exhibit C-6 as a copy of the notice and its delivery record. The only reproduced portion of C-6 is a damaged scan containing the legible fragments '...suspension...' and '...Oct...'; the sender, recipient, date, and delivery outcome cannot be read. The complete notice, envelope, courier receipt, and tracking record are not included in the materials provided for review.
